text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Rollout started: release v2.14 -> canary eu-west-1 (10% traffic). deploy-id=deploy/3421
incident-bot: :warning: SLO alert: 5xx rate 3.7% (baseline 0.2%) on canary-eu-west-1. Triggered at 3412109882
maria.gonzalez: seeing 502s and p95 spikes to ~1s. Seems limited to requests with header x-experiment=redwood-new
kevin_h: I can repro locally with curl -H 'x-experiment: redwood-new' — routing is hitting a new model backend that hasn't finished warmup, returns intermittent 502s
oncall-romesh: I'm paged, pausing rollout. @traffic-manager please hold canary traffic and don't advance to more hosts
traffic-manager: acknowledged — holding canary weight. Setting canary weight -> 0% (drain in progress)
chris_m: running manual rollback to previous routing config now
chris_m: ```bash
./infra/rotator rollback --id deploy/3421 --scope canary --to-tag stable-2.13 --confirm
# rotates route tags, resets header routing, expected traffic shift -> 0% canary
```
traffic-manager: traffic at 0% after 18s. Canary pool drained to 0 connections
maria.gonzalez: smoke check: curl -H 'x-experiment: redwood-new' https://eu.api.redwood/internal/health -> 200 OK, p95 back to ~120ms
lina_support: support update: 12 tickets from EU users, 3 payment flows failed during the window. We've contacted affected customers and opened priority cases
sam_lead: noted. Postmortem actions: add header-sanity check before any rollout that toggles routing headers; require warmup probe for new backends; add an automated canary smoke runner that hits header paths
oncall-romesh: toggled feature flag feature.experiment.routing_safe -> false and annotated incident. Handoff to @kevin_h for longer-term verification and postmortem writeup
kevin_h: I have the lane. I'll run the extended smoke suite against eu-west and open INC ticket with timeline
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved — rollback completed and canary healthy. Duration ~7m. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-3421 and assigning to eng/team-release for follow-up
maria.gonzalez: :thumbsup: thanks everyone, will prepare logs and traces for the postmortem
sam_lead: good job on quick rollback and customer comms. We'll follow up in retro to tighten rollout gating
__note: Single Slack thread string; messages in chronological order; no title per agents.md
